# MakerLens Events

> Free, browser-based, read-only viewer for RPG Maker 2000/2003, XP, VX, VX Ace, MV and MZ events. It shows the dialogue, choices, conditions, switches, variables, labels and jumps of map and common events as an interactive flow graph. Runs 100% client-side: game files are never uploaded.

## What it does

Open a released RPG Maker game (the game folder, or its `data/` folder). For MV and MZ, MakerLens Events parses `MapInfos.json`, `Map###.json`, `CommonEvents.json`, `Actors.json` and `System.json` in your browser. VX Ace, VX and XP games work too: their `Data/*.rvdata2` / `.rvdata` / `.rxdata` files (Ruby Marshal) are read from the folder or from inside `Game.rgss3a` / `.rgss2a` / `.rgssad`. RPG Maker 2000/2003 games work from their folder too (`RPG_RT.ldb`, `RPG_RT.lmt`, `Map####.lmu`, LCF format, Shift-JIS or Western text). Each event page is drawn as a flow graph, with switch, variable and actor names resolved from the game's data. No project, no editor, no plugin.

- Optional save file (XP `.rxdata`, VX `.rvdata`, VX Ace `.rvdata2`, MV `.rpgsave`, MZ `.rmmzsave`): scene previews then follow that save's switches, variables and party (read only, never uploaded)
- Dialogue (including speaker names), choices and their branches
- Conditional branches with readable switch / variable conditions
- Labels and jumps shown as dashed back-edges
- Sidebar: maps in the editor's tree, common events, a scene list and search across maps and events
- Scene preview: plays a dialogue scene with its pictures, face, music and sound, like the game would
- Read-only: the game is never modified

## Who it's for

Guide and wiki writers, dataminers and speedrunners (what unlocks an ending or a hidden route), translators who need to know which branch a line belongs to, and developers or writers who want a bird's-eye view of tangled events. Not an editor: to change events, use the RPG Maker editor. Meant for games you own or have permission to inspect.

## Use it

- App: https://makerlens.kokoroou.com/events/
- FAQ (which folder to open, what the graph shows, finding what unlocks an ending, switch names, privacy): https://makerlens.kokoroou.com/events/faq.html
- Open Chrome or Edge for folder access; other browsers can pick the `data/` files one by one.

## Related

- MakerLens Assets (images and audio of the same game): https://makerlens.kokoroou.com/assets/
- MakerLens home: https://makerlens.kokoroou.com/
- Privacy (no uploads, anonymous counter of page views and of a few actions by name only): https://makerlens.kokoroou.com/assets/privacy.html
